name: CREATE A COFFEE BLEND FORYOU OR A LOVED ONE
SPECIAL BLEND
description: If you enjoy a medium strength coffee, which can be drunk at any time of the day, try our most popular "Special Blend" that has Arabica Peaberry and Arabica Plantation-AA. Tasting Notes This coffee offers an exciting taste which is fuller bodied despite boasting a distinctively deep flavor complimented with spicy highlights, a perfect balance of aroma and strength. It is medium roasted to bring out the robust flavor of Peaberry and moderate acidity of our Plantation "AA".
